preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of problems (1 to 5000), m is the required balance (0 to 10^9).
Input is exactly two integers n and m separated by whitespace.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == n)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a strictly increasing sequence of n positive integers ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda a: sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) for k in range(j+1, n) if int(a[i]) + int(a[j]) == int(a[k])))(stdout.strip().split()) == m
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the sequence must have exactly m triples (i, j, k) where i < j < k and a_i + a_j = a_k.
